+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Configure logging destinations and syslog facilities on ICX switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or global logging switch.
+    type: str
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on, facility]
+  name:
+    description: Hostname or IP address of a syslog server. Required for host.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+    type: str
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility to set or clear.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Logging severity for console or buffered logging.
+    type: str
+    choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings. Each item accepts the destination options.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the specified settings should be present or absent.
+    type: str
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare with the running configuration.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Tested against ICX 10.1.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Add an IPv6 syslog host and set its facility
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: 2001:db8::1
+    udp_port: '514'
+    facility: local7
+
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+
+- name: Set multiple logging options
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: buffered, level: warnings}
+      - {dest: host, name: 192.0.2.1, udp_port: '514'}
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514']
+'''
+
+import re
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+LEVELS = ('emergencies', 'alerts', 'critical', 'errors', 'warnings',
+          'notifications', 'informational', 'debugging')
+DESTINATIONS = ('host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on', 'facility')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    if param is None:
+        param = check
+    return sum(1 for key in param if check.get(key) is not None)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for condition, value, required in spec:
+        if param.get(condition) == value:
+            for key in required:
+                if param.get(key) is None or param.get(key) == '':
+                    module.fail_json(msg='%s is required when %s is %s' % (key, condition, value))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)(?:\s|$)', line.strip())
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^logging host ipv6 \S+', line.strip()))
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    required_if = required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                  ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate')
+    if entries is None:
+        entries = [params]
+    obj = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = dict(entry)
+        for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state'):
+            if item.get(key) is None:
+                item[key] = params.get(key)
+        if count_terms(item, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        check_required_if(module, required_if, item)
+        if item['dest'] == 'facility' and item['state'] == 'present' and item['facility'] is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='facility is required when dest is facility and state is present')
+        if item['udp_port'] is not None:
+            if item['dest'] != 'host':
+                item['udp_port'] = None
+            else:
+                try:
+                    port = int(item['udp_port'])
+                except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be a number from 1 to 65535')
+                if port < 1 or port > 65535:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be a number from 1 to 65535')
+                item['udp_port'] = str(port)
+        item['addr6'] = False
+        if item['dest'] == 'host':
+            item['addr6'] = bool(validate_ip_v6_address(item['name']))
+        else:
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+        if item['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            item['level'] = set([item['level']]) if not isinstance(item['level'], (list, set, tuple)) else set(item['level'])
+            if not item['level'].issubset(set(LEVELS)):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered logging level')
+        elif item['dest'] not in ('console',):
+            item['level'] = None
+        if item['dest'] != 'facility':
+            obj.append(dict(item, facility=None))
+        if item['facility'] is not None or item['dest'] == 'facility':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            facility=item['facility'], level=None, addr6=False,
+                            state=item['state']))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, None, compare=module.params['check_running_config'])
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    buffered = set()
+    buffered_seen = False
+    buffered_disabled = set()
+    logging_off = False
+    for raw in config.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            logging_off = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered_seen = True
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_seen = True
+                buffered.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split(None, 3)[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_disabled.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                            udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                            addr6=parse_address(line, 'host'), facility=None, level=None))
+        elif line == 'logging console' or line.startswith('logging console '):
+            parts = line.split()
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            addr6=False, facility=None,
+                            level=parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else None))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            addr6=False, facility=None, level=None))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            addr6=False, facility=None, level=None))
+    if buffered_seen or buffered_disabled:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False,
+                        facility=None, level=buffered - buffered_disabled))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False,
+                    facility=facility, level=None))
+    if not logging_off:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on', name=None, udp_port=None, addr6=False,
+                        facility=None, level=None))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item['state']
+        current = [h for h in have if h['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'facility':
+            active = current[0]['facility'] if current else 'user'
+            if state == 'present' and item['facility'] != active:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % item['facility'])
+            elif state == 'absent' and active != 'user' and (item['facility'] is None or item['facility'] == active):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'host':
+            matching = []
+            if search_obj_in_list(item['name'], current) is not None:
+                matching = [h for h in current if h['name'] == item['name'] and
+                            h['addr6'] == item['addr6']]
+            def host_command(host):
+                cmd = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if host['addr6'] else '', host['name'])
+                if host['udp_port'] is not None:
+                    cmd += ' udp-port %s' % host['udp_port']
+                return cmd
+            if state == 'absent':
+                for host in matching:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or item['udp_port'] == host['udp_port']:
+                        commands.append('no ' + host_command(host))
+            elif not any(h['udp_port'] == item['udp_port'] for h in matching):
+                for host in matching:
+                    commands.append('no ' + host_command(host))
+                commands.append(host_command(item))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            active = current[0]['level'] if current else set()
+            target = item['level']
+            adds, removes = diff_in_list(target, active)
+            if state == 'present':
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in adds)
+            else:
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in target and level in active)
+        elif dest == 'console':
+            active = current[0] if current else None
+            level = item['level']
+            if state == 'absent':
+                if active and (level is None or active['level'] == level):
+                    commands.append('no logging console' if level is None else 'no logging console %s' % level)
+            elif active is None or active['level'] != level:
+                commands.append('logging console%s' % (' ' + level if level else ''))
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and not current:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(commands))
+
+
+def main():
+    entry_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+                      name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='str'),
+                      facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+                      state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec = dict(entry_spec)
+    argument_spec.update(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=entry_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec['state'] = dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present')
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = icx_logging
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.get_config = self.config_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+        self.get_config.return_value = ''
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_ipv6_host_and_facility(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514\nlogging facility local1'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port='515', facility='local7'),
+                                        dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port='514')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 515',
+            'logging facility local7',
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_host_removal_discovers_port(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_absent_global_console_and_facility(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging console\nlogging facility local7'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='console'), dict(dest='on'),
+                                        dict(dest='facility')], state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging console', 'no logging on',
+                                                    'no logging facility'])
+
+    def test_buffered_disabled_level_and_idempotency(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging buffered debugging'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='warnings', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging buffered warnings'])
+
+    def test_idempotent_ipv6_host_and_facility(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514\nlogging facility local7'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port='514', facility='local7'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_required_options(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+
+    def test_global_and_rfc5424(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'no logging on\nlogging enable rfc5424\nlogging persistence'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='on', state='present'),
+                                        dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent'),
+                                        dict(dest='persistence', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging on',
+                                                    'no logging enable rfc5424',
+                                                    'no logging persistence'])
+
+    def test_check_mode_does_not_load(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', _ansible_check_mode=True))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host 192.0.2.1'])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_console_level_removal_matches_running_level(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging console errors'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='console', level='warnings', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
